summary: Completed frontend E2E testing of CMMS app. Work order creation flow works perfectly with Select component issues resolved. However, discovered session management issues preventing complete testing of all modules.

resolved_issues.description: Previous Select component issues have been resolved

ui_bugs.issue: Login session not persisting properly - users get redirected back to login page after successful authentication
ui_bugs.impact: Prevents proper navigation and testing of protected routes
ui_bugs.symptoms: Login button shows 'PLEASE WAIT...' state and user gets redirected to login page instead of dashboard

passed_tests: Form field interactions (title, description, location, due date)
Select dropdown interactions (no empty value errors)

critical_fixes.details: Login is successful but session is not persisting properly. Users get redirected back to login page instead of staying logged in. This prevents proper navigation to protected routes like Assets, Inventory, PM Schedules, and Reports pages.

completed_fixes.task: Select component empty value errors - RESOLVED
completed_fixes.details: The previous Select component issues have been successfully fixed. Work order creation with priority selection works perfectly.
